events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect T-242 evidence files and push state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls workshop-plan/tasks/evidence/T-242/chain-1557/; cat workshop-plan/tasks/evidence/T-242/chain-1557/summary.txt | head -40; for f in workshop-plan/tasks/evidence/T-242/chain-1557/*.json; do echo "== $f"; python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(open('$f'));print({k:(len(v) if isinstance(v,(list,dict)) else v) for k,v in d.items()}); f=d.get('findings');print('findings',f); j=d.get('jobs'); print('jobs', [ (x.get('name') or x.get('kind'), x.get('status')) for x in (j if isinstance(j,list) else [])][:30])"; done; git log origin/main --oneline -1; git st

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check Kie lines, task evidence, T-424, LOG entry
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; E=workshop-plan/tasks/evidence/T-242/chain-1557; for s in webinar challenge rsp; do python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('$E/report-$s.json'));print('$s',[ {k:v for k,v in x.items() if k in ('kind','type','id','status','job')} for x in d['jobs'] if 'content' in json.dumps(x).lower()])"; done; grep -ril kie $E | head; diff -q $E/summary.txt /tmp/t242c/chain/summary.txt; grep -i kie /tmp/t242c/chain/summary.txt; python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Recheck kie grep, summary diff, walker wait code
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; E=workshop-plan/tasks/evidence/T-242/chain-1557; grep -il kie $E/* ; echo "grep rc=$?"; diff $E/summary.txt /tmp/t242c/chain/summary.txt && echo SAME; ls -la /tmp/t242c/chain/ | head; ls workshop-plan/tasks/evidence/T-242/baseline-probes | head; git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main -- workshop-plan/tasks/evidence/T-242 | head; grep -n -i "kie\|content-schedule" app/scripts/walk-ui.mjs | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Confirm kie mentions are card names; read settle code
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; E=workshop-plan/tasks/evidence/T-242/chain-1557; grep -o -i '"[^"]*kie[^"]*"' $E/*.json | sort | uniq -c; grep -i -c "finding" /tmp/t242c/chain/walk-*.log; grep -i "kie" /tmp/t242c/chain/walk-*.log | grep -v "d1-kie" | head -3; sed -n 343,372p app/scripts/walk-ui.mjs; git ls-files workshop-plan/tasks/evidence/T-242/baseline-probes | wc -l
